propositions: Under rich_text_cutover='cloud', the outbound comment differ computes its dedup key using different decoders for the local and Jira sides, causing markdown comments to fail deduplication against their own landed bodies.
The local key passes through AdfCodec.normalize_outbound (markdown round trip with escaping), while the Jira-side key uses adf_to_text without escaping, producing divergent keys for identical bodies.

The send path encodes a decorated comment body through markdown_to_adf, which degrades to plain text encoding when HTML comments are present, but the local dedup key derives from the undecorated body passed through rich round-trip encoding.

The fix derives the local dedup key by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it through the same _normalize_comment_body decoder used for the Jira side, eliminating the asymmetry.
Markdown-active characters are escaped in the local key but not in the landed key, causing non-matching dedup and duplicate mutation emission for in-limit markdown comments.
The truncation notice exhibits the same asymmetry: local key carries escaped brackets while landed body carries unescaped brackets.
